# Salary and other entitlements

Salary and other entitlements

Learn about your basic rights as an employee.

[Salary paymentsFind out when and how your salary should be paid in different situations.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/paying-salary)[Employment rightsLearn about basic entitlements based on the Employment Act, including overtime, rest day, and paid leave.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/employment-act/workright)[Progressive Wage ModelHelps to uplift low-wage workers in the cleaning, security, and landscape sectors.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/progressive-wage-model/what-is-pwm)

Termination of employment

Either you or your employer can end an employment relationship by terminating the contract of service.

[Termination with noticeFind out the notice period you’re required to serve when you resign and what might affect your notice period.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/termination-of-employment/termination-with-notice)[Guidelines on wrongful dismissalLearn more about what is considered wrongful dismissal and when to file a claim.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/termination-of-employment/wrongful-dismissal)[Maternity leave protectionsIf you’ve worked for your employer for at least 3 months, they cannot dismiss you unfairly during your pregnancy.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/leave/maternity-leave/protections-and-obligations)[Re-employmentIf you’re eligible, your employer is obliged to re-employ you after the retirement age.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/re-employment)[RetirementIf you joined your company before you turned 55, you cannot be forced to retire before the retirement age.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/retirement)

View more

Unsafe working environments

Whether it’s physical or mental, your well-being at work should be protected.

[Workplace harassmentFind out what you can do if you are being harassed at work.](https://www.tal.sg/tafep/Employment-Practices/Workplace-Harassment/Seek-Help-on-Workplace-Harassment)[SnapSAFE: report a workplace safety or health issueNotify the Ministry of Manpower about unsafe workplace conditions. Your identity will be kept confidential.](https://service2.mom.gov.sg/efeedback/Forms/eFeedbackWithReferrer.aspx?option=3)[Work injury compensationYou may be eligible for compensation if you get injured at work.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/workplace-safety-and-health/work-injury-compensation)

Related services

Singpass login may be required.

[File a wrongful dismissal or salary claim](https://www.tal.sg/tadm/eServices/Employees-file-employment-claim)[Appeal under Retirement and Re-employment ActDismissal or denial of re-employment.](https://www.mom.gov.sg/appeal-dismissal)[Report workplace discrimination or harassment](https://www.tal.sg/tafep/Contact-Us)[Report a workplace injury](https://www.mom.gov.sg/eservices/services/wsh-incident-reporting)

View more

[Retrenchment benefits and measures](https://www.life.gov.sg/ways-we-help/retrenchment-benefits-and-measures)[Support for your job search](https://www.life.gov.sg/ways-we-help/support-for-your-job-search)
